name: check_my_email
description: Reads the inbox list of her own Proton Mail account (web only, in her own Firefox, after mama signed her in once in a private window): sender, subject, time, and whether a mail is a verification code. Read-only, never sends mail. Senders, subjects and code digits go to mama's activity log only; the public site and her thought chain only ever see 'got a code from X'.

example.text: jena check your email, did you get a code?
